name: Burn a Cardboard City
subtitle: Incremental destruction game
promotional_text: Someone built a whole city out of cardboard boxes. You are the giant standing next to it with a magnifying glass. Burn it down, block by block.
description:
Someone filled an empty warehouse with a whole city made of cardboard boxes: suburbs of little box houses, a downtown of office boxes, a row of skyscrapers and a castle in the middle. You are the giant standing next to it. It would be a shame if it caught fire.

Hold a magnifying glass on a rooftop until it smokes. Buildings burn, weaken and fall, and a falling building sets off its neighbours. Coins from every collapse buy the next tool: a candle, a blowtorch, a bottle of firework rockets.

- See it through the giant's own eyes: houses up to your knees, offices up to your chest
- Buildings that really burn through and topple into each other in chains
- Four tools, each held in your hand
- Helpers: wind-up cars with a sparkler taped on, and paper planes with a lit fuse
- Little finds in the rubble: a rubber duck, a lost sock, marbles, a very small teddy, and sometimes a golden ticket
- Upgrades for heat, spread, coins and speed
- A real ending in about 30 to 60 minutes; your progress saves as you go

It is a craft project. Nobody lives there but flat paper cut-out people, who hop out and skip off to safety.

Free to play with ads. Watching an ad for a boost (2x fire, a helper rush, extra coins) is always your choice, and a short ad can appear at natural breaks. You never need to watch one or buy anything to finish. A one-time purchase removes the ads and doubles your fire for good.
